[P2] Return to design for the changed completion invariants

Rule 3, item 4 requires an ADR when changing an SDK invariant. These lines replace ADR-003's checkpoint-confirmed step completion and the plugin contract that `onOperationEnd` observes a terminal operation: success is now reported before persistence, so a failed SUCCEED can produce a success end hook followed by another end hook when the step re-executes. The description explicitly chooses this behavior, but the PR includes no ADR. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and document the revised checkpoint, coordination, and plugin contracts in an ADR, considering preservation of the existing lifecycle contract as a simpler direction.
